versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service InputOutputControlByIdentifier (0x2F), the Dcm module shall check if the DID can be control in the current session (see configuration parameter DcmDspDidControlSessionRef ). If not, the Dcm module shall send a NRC 0x31 (Request Out of Range).
